questions.question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

P. having the opportunity of observing people's

Q. we respect and appreciate their point of views

R. the advantage of travelling different places and

S. culture, custom and lifestyle, is that
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence logically begins with the subject: "**R**:** the advantage of travelling different places and".**
 
• Following this, "**P**:** having the opportunity of observing people's"** continues the thought, specifying what the advantage includes.
 
• "**S**:** culture, custom and lifestyle, is that" **completes the specifics of what can be observed.
 
• Finally, "**Q**: **we respect and appreciate their point of views"** wraps up the sentence by explaining the outcome of these observations.

Therefore, the correct answer is **RPSQ**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (RQPS)**: This option starts with "we respect and appreciate their point of views," which does not start the sentence logically.
 
• **Option 2 (PSQR)**: This option starts with "having the opportunity of observing people's," which lacks the initial subject.
 
• **Option 4 (SQPR)**: This option starts with "culture, custom and lifestyle, is that," which does not introduce the advantage of travelling.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The painting was admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.

options.text: The painting was being admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.
Art enthusiasts from around the world admired the painting.
Art enthusiasts from around the world have admired the painting.
The painting has been admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is:** "The painting was admired by art enthusiasts from around the world."**
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject **"art enthusiasts from around the world"** at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form** "was admired" **to the active verb form** "admired."**
 
• Place the object** "the painting"** after the verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** ***"Art enthusiasts from around the world admired the painting."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The painting was being admired by art enthusiasts from around the world." – Incorrect as it is still in passive voice and uses the past continuous tense.
 
• **Option 3:** "Art enthusiasts from around the world have admired the painting." – Incorrect tense; uses present perfect which is not needed for this sentence.
 
• **Option 4:** "The painting has been admired by art enthusiasts from around the world." – Incorrect as it is still in passive voice and uses present perfect tense.

options.text: So worried, confused or annoyed that she does not know what to do next
So worried, confused or annoyed that she became unconscious
So calm and composed that she knows what to do next

• **Example:** She was **at her wits' end** trying to manage the unruly children.
 
 
 
• **Worried** refers to feeling anxious or concerned about something. (चिंतित)

• Hence, we can infer that the idiom **'at her wits' end'** means being in a state of extreme worry or confusion.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

He will be made President by the people.

options.text: People will be making him the President.
The people will make him President.
By the people, he shall be made the President.
He will be made President by the people.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of** the active voice sentence** becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is:** "He will be made President by the people."**
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject** "the people"** at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form** "will be made" **to the active verb form** "will make."**
 
• Place the object **"him"** after the verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** ***"The people will make him President."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Option 3:** "By the people, he shall be made the President." – Incorrect word order; remains passive.
 
• **Option 4:** "He will be made President by the people." – This is the original passive voice sentence.
